commands.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "SOURCE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo 'HOST_MEMORY_LOAD'; uptime; vm_stat | head -10
echo 'CHECK_GIT_CHANGE' ; git log -1 --oneline
echo 'FOCUSED_DELETION_AND_MODAL'
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec vitest run src/features/plugs/components/PlugDeleteConfirmModal.test.tsx src/features/plugs/components/PlugRemovalBlockedModal.test.tsx src/features/thermometers/components/SensorRemovalBlockedModal.test.tsx src/__tests__/modal.test.tsx --reporter=default
echo 'TYPECHECK'
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile typecheck
echo 'FORMATTING_AND_QUALITY'
pnpm exec prettier --check apps/mobile/src/features/plugs/components/PlugDeleteConfirmModal.test.tsx apps/mobile/src/features/plugs/components/PlugDeleteConfirmModal.tsx
pnpm quality:ux
echo 'WORKTREE_AFTER';git status --short
